create_Wav2Vec2Processor: create a Wav2Vec2Processor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer for speech recognition
run_Wav2Vec2Processor_call_audio: run Wav2Vec2Processor __call__ to extract audio features from raw audio input
run_Wav2Vec2Processor_call_text: run Wav2Vec2Processor __call__ to tokenize text input for speech recognition labels
run_Wav2Vec2Processor_call_both: run Wav2Vec2Processor __call__ with both audio and text to produce features and labels together
build_Wav2Vec2Processor_pad: build padded batches of input features and labels using Wav2Vec2Processor pad method
